title: Danish man sues OpenAI, claiming ChatGPT's rent advice led to eviction and homelessness
summary_full: Klaus Elmfelt Aerenlund, a 60-year-old from Denmark, found himself homeless after acting on legal advice from ChatGPT that led to his eviction. He halted rent payments, convinced by the chatbot's statements that eviction was unlikely. Consequently, he experienced significant emotional turmoil and isolation while living in his car. Now, he seeks not only damages but also measures to prevent similar AI-related repercussions in the future.
